title: Para Bellum content: settlement types
description: What each settlement type the map produces is worth. File: Content/<namespace>/settlement.json. There is exactly one row per settlement type, listed in Content/vocabulary.json as settlement_types, INCLUDING none: a hex with no settlement gets an explicit row of zeros, so nothing in the game falls back to a silent default. A mod cannot override this file (a recorded limitation). The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

type.description: A settlement type the map produces: none, suburb, town, city or metropolis.

income.description: Money per month from a seat of this type.

manpower.description: Manpower per month from a seat of this type.

facility_slots.description: Facility slots a province seat of this type provides.

training_slots.description: Concurrent training orders a seat of this type supports.

tier.description: The settlement's rank, used where a province has no capital to choose its capture seat.
